data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 街角书店
data.description: 午后的街角书店里，麻衣换上茶棕灯芯绒外套、象牙白高领针织衫和藏蓝直筒长裤，倚着书架，双手托住刚选好的文集，用摊开的书页遮住唇边的笑。近处小展示台上摆着几本封面朝上的书与纸书签，木书架向后转进较窄的阅读过道，尽头可见店门磨砂玻璃。暖色吊灯从右上照亮书页断面、兔子发夹与外套纹理，书背间留出较暗缝隙——「没想到你也会对这种古典小说感兴趣……读完之后，要不要和我交换一下读后感？」
data.location: 街角书店文集书架旁，阅读过道延伸至磨砂玻璃店门
data.action: 倚着书架，双手托住打开的文集，让书页遮住唇边，望向画面外的同行者。
data.lighting: warm pendant light from the upper right on page edges and corduroy; dimmer shelf recesses
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, open book and bookshop aisle visible
data.promptProse: Between the essay shelves and a low book display, Mai hides a small smile behind the opened volume supported in both hands. Her rabbit-shaped clip remains visible in straight black hair above a tea-brown corduroy jacket and ivory turtleneck; navy trousers accompany the quiet afternoon outfit. Several face-up books and paper bookmarks occupy the display at the near edge. Behind her shoulder, wooden cases turn into a narrow reading aisle that ends at the shop's frosted entrance glass. Keep her eyes, both supporting hands and the aisle in an eye-level medium view. A warm pendant above to the right reveals worn page edges and the jacket's fine ribs. Overlapping book shadows darken the shelf recesses, while the frosted door contributes a softer pale background plane.
